个人简介Biography

我目前是 字节跳动 Seed 的资深研究员，主要关注多模态生成，尤其是 R2V 与 Post-Training。代表工作包括 Seedance 2.5 和 Seedance 2.0。

I am currently a Senior Researcher at ByteDance Seed, focusing on multimodal generation, especially R2V and post-training. Representative work includes Seedance 2.5 and Seedance 2.0.

此前，我在字节跳动智能创作实验室从事视频生成与智能创作研究，参与了 Phantom（1.5k★）、HuMo（1.3k★） 和 DreaMontage 等工作。

Previously, I worked in ByteDance's Intelligent Creation Lab on video generation and intelligent creation. I contributed to projects including Phantom (1.5k★), HuMo (1.3k★), and DreaMontage.

我本科毕业于华中科技大学，硕士毕业于中国科学院自动化研究所。2017 年硕士毕业后加入字节跳动 AI Lab，从事视频理解研究；此后参与了一键成片等智能创作能力建设，并支持 剪映 等产品功能。

I received my B.Eng. from HUST and my M.Eng. from CASIA. After graduating in 2017, I joined ByteDance AI Lab to work on video understanding, and later contributed to intelligent-creation features such as one-click video creation for Jianying.

DreaMontage: Arbitrary Frame-Guided One-Shot Video Generation

深度参与。支持任意时间点的图像、视频与混合条件，在 one-shot 框架中统一关键帧控制、转场、延长与多段连接。Deep contribution to arbitrary-timestamp image, video, and mixed conditioning for keyframe control, transitions, extension, and multi-clip connection.

OmniInsert (CVPR 2026 Findings)

面向任意参考主体的无掩码视频插入，在不同场景中兼顾主体与场景平衡以及插入后的视觉协调。Mask-free video insertion for arbitrary references, with an emphasis on subject-scene equilibrium and insertion harmonization across diverse scenarios.
